opportunities.title: Small grants

amount.raw: Awards generally fall in a range of £1,500-£5,000 and will only exceptionally exceed £6,000; travel funding up to £2,000-£2,500 per person; PhD fieldwork visits up to £5,000; Japan office up to ¥300,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution willing to receive grant funds. Applications are not accepted from individuals seeking support for personal projects. Not for undergraduate or master's students.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for projects that bring people in the UK and Japan together to deepen mutual understanding, encourage exchange of ideas or expertise, or develop lasting collaboration between the two nations.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: Up to £10,000; continuing projects lasting up to three years to a maximum of £10,000 per year, to a total limit of £30,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally show an existing research record; consideration also given to practitioners, managers, carers or others in health-related fields. Projects must involve partners in both the UK and Japan. Preference to those not previously involved in UK-Japan collaboration and early-career applicants.
opportunities.summary: Support exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, including study of scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare.
